fusions.name: Puffball Burst
fusions.desc: Bursts a cloud of smouldering spores that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and sets each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Punkwood Finish
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction you have on the target, adding their remaining damage to the hit and 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Smoking Mound
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to raise a smoking mound of caps beside you for 15 seconds. It sheds embers on enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds, and each hit has a 30% chance to set the target [Burning] for 4 seconds. It taunts your last target.

fusions.name: Takes Root Anywhere
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You have 8% fire resistance.
